mainEntity.name: What kind of tenants typically rent tiny homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Tiny homes attract a diverse range of tenants, often those seeking affordability, minimalism, and a smaller environmental footprint. This can include young professionals, students, single individuals, or couples who appreciate efficient living spaces. Retirees or empty nesters looking to downsize and reduce expenses are also a common demographic. Additionally, tiny homes can serve as short-term rentals for tourists or temporary housing for those new to an area. Their appeal often lies in lower utility costs and a simpler lifestyle.
acceptedAnswer.description: Tiny homes attract tenants seeking affordability and minimalism, such as young professionals, students, single individuals, couples, and retirees, or as short-term rentals.
